messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-03-28] standup/cinder/2025-03-28: The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails.
- [2025-03-28] standup/ember/2025-03-28: If feature-flags is down, the job scheduler is down: it relies on it for per-job kill switches.
- [2025-11-03] standup/dune/2025-11-03: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for Dune starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-05-28] standup/dune/2025-05-28: Reminder: the scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-05-28] standup/ember/2025-05-28: Observation from Ember: after the cache change, Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week. Reminder: Oskar Lind is on call for team Ember this cycle.
- [2025-03-31] standup/dune/2025-03-31: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2026-03-09] standup/dune/2026-03-09: Dune sits on the fourth floor.
- [2025-02-28] standup/atlas/2025-02-28: Reminder that Ledger only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for Dune goes to Farah.
- [2026-05-28] standup/cinder/2026-05-28: Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager.
- [2025-02-28] handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer: Quick one: the indexer belongs to the Boreal team starting today. Thanks to Cinder for running it until now.
- [2026-06-03] standup/dune/2026-06-03: Reminder from team Dune: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Farah.
- [2025-03-05] standup/dune/2025-03-05: Reporting deploy window: on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2026-01-14] standup/dune/2026-01-14: Reminder: Tomasz is on call for team Dune this cycle.
- [2025-11-03] standup/dune/2025-11-03-2: For newcomers: the deploy window for the job scheduler is still on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today. Team Dune saw that the ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-25] handover/2026-03-25-billing-api: The billing API has a new home: team Dune. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-03-20] standup/dune/2026-03-20: Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2025-03-03] standup/boreal/2025-03-03: Dependency map update: the search indexer needs the product catalog (product documents).
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: Reminder from Boreal: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Lena.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2026-03-13] standup/boreal/2026-03-13: Deploy freeze for the ledger: 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 (the fiscal year close).
- [2025-03-27] standup/cinder/2025-03-27: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-03-14] standup/atlas/2025-03-14: Dependency map update: the ledger needs the auth gateway (service tokens).
- [2025-03-24] standup/atlas/2025-03-24: The billing API can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11: Policy: every the auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-03-21] standup/ember/2025-03-21: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2026-03-18] standup/boreal/2026-03-18: Reminder that the product catalog depends on the resizer.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31-2: We agreed today that the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. The reason is that the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11-2: Observation from team Ember: after the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-05-15] standup/dune/2025-05-15-2: Reminder: the job scheduler is owned by Dune.
- [2025-04-23] standup/dune/2025-04-23: Team Dune adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: For the record, image-resizer is owned by team Dune.

Question: Who was on call for Dune on 2025-03-28?
